title: Reflexive verbs
explanation:
A reflexive verb uses a pronoun that matches the subject. Llamarse is the verb for names: me llamo, te llamas, se llama, nos llamamos, os llamáis, se llaman.

Me llamo Ana means my name is Ana. The pronoun sits before the conjugated verb. Os is the Spain form for a group you know.
commonMistake: Mixing the pronoun and the ending, as in me llamas or se llamo.

examples.english: Our names are Ana and Pablo.
Your names are Ana and Pablo.
